paras: Atractus emigdioi, also known commonly as Emigdio's ground snake, is a species of snake in the family Colubridae. The species is endemic to Venezuela.
The specific name, emigdioi, is in honor of Emigdio González-Sponga who collected the holotype.
A. emigdioi is found in the Cordillera de Mérida in the Venezuelan states of Mérida and Trujillo.
The preferred natural habitat of A. emigdioi is forest, at altitudes of 2,100–3,000 m (6,900–9,800 ft).
A. emigdioi is terrestrial and semifossorial.
